snippet.title: Big Fish Official Release Trailer (2021)
snippet.description:
To celebrate going on steam and humble bundle, I have released a new trailer video along a MASSIVE UPDATE with tons of new content! Make sure to get Big Fish from the link below and subscribe to the video devlog series!

Get the game here:   https://toq-games.itch.io/big-fish

Video devLog Series:   https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ5lB4RnYtu8OCq-esx3FNcFXV9-70aXq
